messages:
Claire: postmortem follow-up: I mapped the action lifecycle (owner -> canary -> monitor -> promote/rollback). sharing recommended small-surgery items to cut down pages without hiding real incidents. link: https://internal.redwood/pm/actions-2026 :sparkles:
Diego: nice map. can we also assign an "action champion" per cluster so changes don't drift?
Claire: yes  proposing rotating champions for 4 weeks per cluster. champion is responsible for PR, canary, and 14d post-rollout review.
Mina: I'll champ the gateway cluster (api-rate spikes + kvcache flap). plan: 1) canary dedupe group_by=path_prefix, window=3m 2) safety gate allow_urgent_if=error_rate>0.2 3) monitor suppression_rate + missed_alert_estimate. ETA canary tomorrow.
Diego: I'll champ auth-db alerts. approach: move to 99.5th pctl, add 3m hysteresis, and add a soft alert (non-pager) for context collection before page. PR by Thu.
Claire: for model-serving OOMs, short-term memory cushion + soft-oom non-pager for 48h, then consider rate-limit. Mina/Diego note owners to notify for heavy models.
Mina: sample canary snippet (pseudo):
```
policy: gateway-dedupe-v1
group_by: path_prefix
window: 180s
max_pages: 1
allow_urgent_if: error_rate > 0.2
```
Mina: will push to canary-region and run synthetic churn, will post results here.
runbook-bot: Created INF-5140 "gateway dedupe canary" assigned to Mina, due 2026-04-08.
Diego: safety metric idea: if suppression_rate > 0.85 for 30m OR missed_alert_estimate > 0.01 for 15m -> auto-rollback + page infra-oncall. add both to dashboard.
Claire: agree. add a slack webhook and dashboard tiles for suppression_rate, missed_alert_estimate, and suppression_impact. champion must declare rollback criteria in PR description.
Mina: timeline recap: Mina (gateway canary) results by Tue AM; Diego (auth threshold PR) by Thu; Claire (runbook + dashboards) updates by EOD today. weekly follow-up: Fri 09:15 20m.
Diego: paging policy tweak proposal: Critical -> 2 pings immediate then escalate at 5m; High -> single page then suppress duplicates for 20m with owner notify; Medium -> channel only. include ack escalation flow.
Claire: please include explicit rollback steps in the runbook: 1) pause canary 2) rollback rule 3) page infra-oncall 4) re-open postmortem action.
ops-bot: Linked postmortem PMT-2026-05 to INF-5140, INF-5141.
Mina: quick question  how do we avoid suppressing correlated failures? e.g. multi-endpoint outage looks like duplicates.
Diego: use allow_urgent_if gates (error_rate or surge_rate) and also add cross-service correlation check before suppression applies. champion should add correlation keys to group_by where possible.
Claire: good. action items logged in the postmortem action sheet. champions please update status when PRs are created and when canary metrics hit thresholds. I'll update the action tracker before EOD. :white_check_mark:
